notes.title: Update Notes for 19/09/25
notes.notes: A few backend updates this time, plus the splash screen has been reverted. Nothing major, just keeping things tidy.

notes.title: Update Notes for 03/09/25
notes.notes:
[p]Fixed crashes caused by the recent SteamVR update. The app should now run smoothly again with the latest version of SteamVR. [/p][p]You may need to uninstall, reinstall the app and rea-enable the driver in SteamVR -> Settings -> Startup / Shut Down -> Manage Add Ons

Thanks for your patience![/p]

notes.title: Major Update - Delayed Announcement
notes.notes:
A lot of new features and improvements were already shipped in the update that came with the SteamVR update mid September. Those and the rest of the new features are detailed below
[list]
[*] Strafing added to both controllers
[*] Improved driver stability, compatibility and performance 
[*] Preliminary WMR support added
[*] Trigger activation added
[*] Experimental 'HMD rotation cancel' feature added
[*] Autosprint bug fixed
[*] Demo timeout increased to 2 mins
[*] Rejigged the tutorial
[/list]
